name: @lilitoweiwei/dsh-web-search-tavily
description: Minimal Tavily-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web). Registers a single search provider; keys resolve from the 'credentials' service (TAVILY_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY_2, …) with config.apiKey as fallback, and rotate per search, parking a key whose plan quota is exhausted.
